text_block_list.text:
TM Opera O, who has brilliantly conquered 
this year's Arima Kinen.

"With this victory—a rare and magnificent 
feat has been achieved."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, the Triple Crown! It's the Autumn 
Senior Triple Crown, Trainer-kun!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn), the Japan Cup, and 
the Arima Kinen. To think she'd win every 
single one of those prestigious races!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, it is so painful being loved so 
dearly by victory... Is this the 
inescapable fate of a star...?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Come, let us hold a parade to celebrate 
this great feat, Trainer!
(WOOOAAAHH!)

After parading through the city, a 
commemorative gift was presented in honor 
of completing the Autumn Senior Triple 
Crown.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, the commemorative gift I 
specifically requested to be made... It's 
finally time for the unveiling ceremony.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ready, and, FLAP!
(FLAP!)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Behold! This is the monument commemorating 
the Senior Autumn Triple Crown, the "T.M. 
Opera O Statue"!

It was a terribly elaborate statue. So 
much so that it looked as if it might 
start moving at any moment...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, truly exquisite work. Such 
breathtaking sculptural beauty... It's as 
if it holds my very soul.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: What's more, I can even do this pose!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Mm, what an utterly star-like countenance. 
It almost makes one want to bow down and 
worship it.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: And what's more—!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Even this pose! Because I had it made with 
48 points of articulation!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
There's a rich selection of optional parts 
too, from scepters to holy swords. It was 
well worth commissioning that factory in 
Shizuoka.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, displaying it at the school gate 
would be fine, but I think I'll take this 
back to my room.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, my fans don't need to worship a 
statue. As long as they come to the 
racetrack, they can see me anytime."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to add this to the collection in 
my room. With another 'me' around, my 
roommate [maid] is sure to be thrilled.

When I pictured it, it felt like something 
out of a horror story.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"In any case, Trainer-kun. Thanks in part 
to your work as my kingmaker, I've managed 
to obtain this splendid treasure."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However, it's still not enough! I need 
more of this Opera statue! More, more!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Enough so that one day, I could form the 
Opera Twelve Heavenly Generals in my room.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun, let's definitely aim for the 
Autumn Senior Triple Crown next year as 
well.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And someday, I shall fill this entire room 
with myself.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Press the button on the opera statue, too. 
*click*

text_block_list.name: Opera O and Others
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!

A T.M. Opera O statue complete with voice 
features. A duet of laughter echoes 
through the year-end sky.

Whatever the commemorative prize is, your 
achievement remains the same. 
Congratulations, T.M. Opera O!
